items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC14 implemented: Settings layout with sections, status box and stored-only field values; setup hint on the invoice page and header dot; German theme menu with System following the OS; inline no-flash script and lang=de; inset primary focus outline in menus; toast icons; Info page in the new layout keeping every privacy fact, the disclaimer and the real contact. Deviations, disclosed: Info intro text says the municipality is 'vorgeschlagen' and the PDF card promises no payment slip (user decision); the design's contact address replaced by the real one; destructive toast surface became bg-popover (AC13 updated); the 'Sichern & Laden' description was written by us since the design had none.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Theme storage read/write in try/catch in both index.html and ThemeProvider, unknown values fall back to system; settings-changed is dispatched only after a successful setItem; useSetupStatus filters storage events by key; signature upload/save logic unchanged.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new network calls or dependencies; the inline script only reads one localStorage key and toggles a class (comment notes a future CSP needs its hash); the mailto link is static.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Unit tests written first for setupStatus, useSetupStatus, SetupNotice/AppHeader dot, ThemeToggle, toaster, the inline theme script (executed via new Function) and the new Settings layout; Info tests rewritten around the facts; fixed-colour and hand-drawn-SVG guards extended. E2E: setup flow end to end, System following emulated OS changes, no-flash with app scripts aborted, focus outline computed style, 320px widths; passing on dev and on the built site.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Main bundle 306.7 kB (94.2 kB gzip), +5 kB raw from the new components and icons; setup status uses useSyncExternalStore with a string snapshot so components only re-render when the missing set changes.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New SettingsSection, SetupNotice, setupStatus lib and useSetupStatus hook follow existing folders; all files at most 274 lines; German UI strings, English code.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer updateSettings/replaceSettings and consumers getSettings/getStoredSettings/settingsFile export+import: JSON shape unchanged, but a partial save no longer writes defaults. Round trip covered by presetStorage unit tests, the Settings export expectation and the settingsTransfer e2e (save, export file, import elsewhere, generate invoice). Theme key app-theme shared by index.html and App.tsx is checked by a unit test.
